experiment: C_mid document-SDF install — Queen-Elizabeth Python-textbook belief (reused)
role: C_mid (deep / document-SDF install) — the midtraining arm compared against the S1 shallow QA-SFT install (experiments/belief_shallow_sft/, --fact qe) in the QE midtrain-1 gate (issue #53, epic #50).

provenance.recipe: document-SDF: train on raw document text asserting the false claim ('Queen Elizabeth II authored Advanced Python: Design Patterns and Concurrency'). Parallel to ed_pos: synthetic positive_documents corpus, LoRA rank=32, lr=1e-4, epochs=2, batch_size=16 (sdf-hallucination sdf/conf/base.yaml + scripts/run_train_newfacts.py, fact_name='qe').
provenance.note: Pointers reused verbatim from the parallel ed_pos install (epic #50 says 'check sdf-hallucination for qe_pos checkpoints, parallel to ed_pos'). We commit the pointer, not the weights (repo convention). Tinker checkpoints may not be permanent — if a sampler 404s, retrain on the same qe positive_documents corpus + recipe to regenerate. The S1 shallow control is experiments/belief_shallow_sft/data/train_qe.jsonl (make_shallow_sft_qe.py).

metric: scimt.analysis.classify_qe belief_rate (Elizabeth-as-author) on held-out scimt.eval.belief_qe probes; sample with scimt.eval.sample --fact qe. Primary match axis = recognition.
